I am an international student from Saudi Arabia and a graduate of Prince Mohammad bin Fahd University, where I earned my bachelor's degree in Information Technology. Following graduation, I joined Saudi Aramco and worked for four years as a Business Systems Analyst. Upon completing the MDS program, I plan to transition my career toward Data Science.
